title: THE FABRIC OF SPACETIME
narration_text: Einstein's General Theory of Relativity revolutionized how we perceive the universe. Gravity is not a magnetic pulling force; it is the geometric bending of spacetime. Massive cosmic bodies, like stars and black holes, warp the grid of space around them like a heavy ball on a rubber sheet. Near these massive wells, time itself slows down relative to a distant observer. The stronger the gravity, the slower the clock ticks.
